'''Seven Cryptical Books of Hsan''' is a [[unique item]].  It first appeared in the [[Dunwich Horror]] expansion.

==Card info==
'''Type''': [[Tome]]

'''Any Phase''': Exhaust instead of spending 1 [[Sanity]] when casting a [[spell]]

'''Price''': $6

==Mythos Source==
The Seven Cryptical Books of Hsan first appeared in ''The Other Gods'' (1921), written by H.P. Lovecraft.
